context.purpose: Knowledge the team needs to plan and run the SSO login rollout.
context.goal: Prepare the SSO login rollout plan for the app

section.name: facts
section.item: Entra ID supports OIDC and SAML 2.0
The company uses Microsoft Entra ID
The app has about 5000 active users
The app currently has e-mail + password login
Graph API limit: 10k requests / 10 min per app
Audit: no rate limit on /login

section.name: decisions
section.item: We roll out SSO via OIDC with Entra ID
SSO rollout deadline: 30 November

section.name: tasks
section.item: Register the app in Entra (redirect URI, scopes)
E2E tests of the OIDC flow (happy path + consent denied)
Account mapping: e-mail → Entra oid

section.item: What about users outside the tenant (B2B guests)?
